submitted.rationale: XRD shows a single rutile/trirutile-type phase from Co0.74 to Co0.52 (indices 7 and 14). Extra Sb-oxide peaks appear at Sb ≥0.67 (indices 20 and 26). Of the three EQE measurements, index 14 (Co0.52Sb0.48) was the only clearly positive one at 0.072%. Index 7 read -0.008% and index 18 read -0.015%, so the photoactivity peaks near the middle of the composition line.
